answer: The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. Each attempt carries a waiting period of 26 days that no payment can shorten, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. A seat is earned, not claimed: Decreed hurdle maker mountain writ makes sure of that, since a writ makers sign after wattle audits. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. sparrow stays on the record. The mesa is on the docket. The clerk notes mirror.
